verdicts.reason: Both banners break up the original couplets. In each, 'When Life Is Rough' sits small in the top-left corner while its 'PRAY' floats much lower and off to the right, and the second 'PRAY' is noticeably bigger than the first. That kills the parallel structure, and with no type stepped up for the wide format the hierarchy is weak. Both also blow the thin divider up into a heavy bar that runs the full height, and the rose is shrunk and squeezed against the right edge, leaving large dead gaps. A ranks marginally ahead only because its first 'PRAY' sits a little closer to its own line; B pushes it further right, which makes the layout look even more scattered.
